thread:
Maya G: Quick sync — Tribe Spark webinar is next Wed. We need: launch post copy, a short benchmark narrative for the refapp, webinar slides, and inbound routing for leads. Who can own which piece?
Alex R: I can take launch post + email copy. Draft by Monday? :spiral_calendar:
Samir (DevRel): I’ll own the refapp tutorial + quick demo deck. Need a kept-to-10-min live demo and a 3-step tutorial folks can follow after.
Lina P: I’ll handle webinar ops + inbound routing mapping. Can we get the expected lead flows?
Tom (Bench): I’ll run a lightweight benchmark (latency + cost) on the refapp using the new quantized model. ETA EOD Tue. Will include a 1-paragraph narrative and a small table.
Maya G: Perfect. Alex — tone for launch post should be dev-first, highlight predictable latency and cost savings. Call out migration story: hosted -> dedicated -> private.
Alex R: Got it. Short subject lines ideas: "Try Tribe Spark: refapp + real-world latency benchmarks" or "Ship LLM features with predictable inference costs". Leaning toward the first.
Samir (DevRel): For the tutorial, keep steps minimal: 1) clone refapp 2) set API key 3) run the demo container. I'll add a troubleshooting FAQ. Can someone provide a small sample prompt set for the demo?
Tom (Bench): I’ll export a 10-prompt set from our perf harness. Will annotate which prompts show the biggest cost delta when batching vs. single-run.
Lina P: For inbound routing, proposed mapping:
```
- webinar@redwood.com -> marketing@zendesk (tag: tribe-webinar)
- downloads@redwood.com -> devrel@intercom (tag: refapp-download)
- enterprise-interest@redwood.com -> sales@sf (priority: high, tag: ent)
```
We should also add a hidden UTMs mapping: utm_campaign=tribe_spark_webinar, utm_source=devcontent.
Maya G: Love the UTMs. Alex — can you add a gated assets CTA so downloads flow into downloads@ with form capturing company size & infra needs?
Alex R: Yup — simple form w/ fields: name, email, company, infra (hosted/dedicated/private). I’ll wire the CTA to downloads@.
Samir (DevRel): Quick check on timing: Samir + Tom need a staging refapp build to run the demo. OpsBot: any scheduled maintenance Wed morning?
OpsBot: No maintenance scheduled for 2026-04-22.
Lina P: Next steps summary:
- Alex: Draft launch post + email copy by Mon EOD.
- Samir: Tutorial + demo deck by Tue noon.
- Tom: Bench results + narrative by Tue EOD.
- Lina: Configure inbound routing + UTMs by Tue EOD.
- Maya: Review copy + coordinate publish timings.
Maya G: Thanks team. Can we do a 30-min dress rehearsal Tue 3pm PT? RSVP here. :thumbsup:
Alex R: RSVP'd
Samir (DevRel): RSVP'd
Tom (Bench): RSVP'd
Lina P: RSVP'd
Maya G: Pushed a placeholder calendar invite. If anyone needs to swap times ping me.
